title: This Terrific Telescopic Charging Stand Is 50 Percent Off Right Now
gist: This is a thin, affiliate-driven product deal post for the Mophie MagSafe 3-in-1 Extendable Wireless Charging Stand, now $76 (from $150) — product marketing, not market or industry analysis, with no thesis-level signal beyond a single accessory's price cut and features.

insights.claim: This Wired post is explicitly an editor-selected, retailer-compensated affiliate deal writeup for the Mophie MagSafe 3-in-1 Extendable Wireless Charging Stand, not independent market analysis.
insights.speaker: Simon Hill
insights.so_what: No investable thesis here beyond noting Wired/Conde Nast's affiliate-commerce content model; treat this article as promotional, not a signal on consumer electronics demand or Mophie/Apple accessory trends.
insights.quote: All products featured on WIRED are independently selected by our editors. However, we may receive compensation from retailers and/or from purchases of products through these links.

insights.claim: The Mophie MagSafe 3-in-1 Extendable Wireless Charging Stand is discounted to $76 from a $150 list price (about 49% off) at both Amazon and Best Buy, which the reviewer says is the lowest price he has seen for it despite prior discounts.
insights.speaker: Simon Hill
insights.so_what: A one-off ~49% discount event on a single SKU; useful only as a data point on discount depth/frequency in the Apple-accessory deal cycle, not a durable trend signal.

insights.claim: The stand's differentiating feature versus other 3-in-1 MagSafe chargers is a telescoping pole that adjusts the iPhone charging pad's height from 7.5 to 16 inches, which the reviewer says he hasn't seen on any competing charger.
insights.speaker: Simon Hill
insights.so_what: Height adjustability is framed as a genuine product differentiator in an otherwise commoditized MagSafe-charger category, relevant only to accessory-market product-design observers.
insights.quote: Height adjustment is not a feature I’ve ever seen in another charger
insights.locator: If you have issues with the height

insights.claim: The stand delivers 15 watts to a MagSafe-certified iPhone (MFi and Qi-certified), plus 5 watts each to an Apple Watch and wireless-charging AirPods, and ships with a 36-watt power supply and 5-foot USB-C cable.
insights.speaker: Simon Hill
insights.so_what: Spec-level detail only; confirms the product sits within standard Apple MagSafe/Qi power ceilings rather than pushing any new charging-speed frontier.
insights.locator: The Mophie MagSafe 3-in-1 Charging Stand is both MFi and Qi-certified
